screens.penny: Hi, {name}! You can earn coins by helping at home.

cards.caption: Sweeping the floor helps everyone at home.
Watering the plants is a small, kind job.

screens.prompt: Which of these help at home?
screens.pennyHint: Does it make things better for everyone, {name}?
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! A job helps somebody else, not just you.
screens.doneMessage: All sorted, {name}! Small jobs at home help a lot.

screens.story: Jayden's dad pays 2 coins for each dog walk. Jayden walks the dog twice.
screens.prompt: How many coins did Jayden earn?

options.label: 4 coins
options.outcome: 2 and 2 makes 4. Jayden earned 4 coins for two walks.

options.label: 2 coins
options.outcome: That is one walk. Jayden did two walks, so he earned more.

screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! Two walks at 2 coins each makes 4 coins.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Count both walks: 2 coins and 2 more is 4.

screens.prompt: Tap 4 coins to put Jayden's earnings in his jar.
screens.rightMessage: 4 coins, {name}! That's exactly what Jayden earned.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Jayden earned 4 coins. Count them again.

screens.prompt: Before you start a job for coins, what do you do?
screens.pennyHint: A job works best when everyone agrees, {name}.
screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! Agree the job and the coins first. No surprises.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Agreeing first is fair to you and to them.
screens.retryIntro: One more look, {name}. What comes first?

screens.title: Nice work, {name}!
screens.message: Helping at home is real work. Real work can earn coins.
